sections.body: Auto liability insurance. Pays for injuries and damage you cause to others; required in nearly every US state.

sections.heading: In depth
sections.body: Liability has two parts: bodily injury (medical costs of others) and property damage (their vehicle or property). State minimums are often far below what a serious crash costs, so higher limits are widely recommended. Educational content only — not financial advice. Consult a licensed insurance professional for your situation.

Auto liability insurance. Pays for injuries and damage you cause to others; required in nearly every US state.

In depth.
Liability has two parts: bodily injury (medical costs of others) and property damage (their vehicle or property). State minimums are often far below what a serious crash costs, so higher limits are widely recommended. Educational content only — not financial advice. Consult a licensed insurance professional for your situation.
